summary: Selectis Health, Inc. via wholly-owned subsidiaries sold two skilled nursing facilities (Glen Eagle and Eastman) in Georgia for an aggregate $15.7 million cash, netting roughly $9 million after debt paydown and establishing $1.57 million in escrows for potential indemnity claims. The purchase agreement with GA SNF Abbeville GA LLC and GA SNF Eastman GA LLC closed on May 1, 2026. Concurrently, facility operators transferred all operations to Purchaser's subsidiaries without additional consideration. Pro forma financials reflecting the divestiture and loan repayment are filed as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for post-close escrow releases and any indemnity claims by Purchaser.
